'''Ananda Dwyce''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Ananda made a decision to flee [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] and join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] since she saw how evil the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was. [[Wilhalm Skrim]] sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find Ananda and arrest her before she could escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The spacer successfully found Ananda who was been escorted by two Rebels. The spacer immediately killed the two escorts and spared Ananda. She was apprehended and later [[Death/Legends|executed]] by the Empire.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommonerHumanFemale.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Ananda Dwyce]]
Ananda Dwyce was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" />
